First tagged release of goant, a JavaScript engine in pure Go.

- **99.4% of Test262**, nothing excluded (53,247 / 53,573)
- ES2025 with modules, `Temporal` and `Intl`
- Baseline JIT for amd64 and arm64, worth 3.1x over Octane
- No cgo, one static binary, cross-compiles wherever Go does

Binaries below are the `goant` CLI for six platforms. It runs the JIT by
default; `goant -jit=false` turns it off.

To embed the package: `go get github.com/robomotionio/goant` (the JIT is
opt-in there, via `WithJIT(true)`).
